title: Proteomic LC-MS/MS Data Acquisition
author: Yan Chen

Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis is performed with a Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) coupled with an Agilent 1290 Infinity UHPLC system (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA). steps.title: Set up autosampler and columns
steps.instruction: Cool the autosampler to 4 °C, install the Agilent InfinityLab Poroshell 120 EC‑C18 analytical column (2.1 mm ID × 100 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 120 Å pores, Cat.#695675‑902) together with the Agilent InfinityLab Poroshell 120 EC‑C18 guard column (2.1 mm ID × 5 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 160 Å pores, Cat.#821725‑940), and set the column oven to 60 °C.

steps.title: Load peptide sample
steps.instruction: Inject exactly 20 µg of peptide digest from each sample onto the prepared column.

steps.title: Prepare mobile phases
steps.instruction: Prepare Solvent A as 0.1 % formic acid in water and Solvent B as 0.1 % formic acid in acetonitrile.

steps.title: Program LC gradient
steps.instruction: Set the UHPLC flow rate to 0.4 mL min⁻¹ and program the following 15‑minute gradient (10‑minute linear elution): Step 1 – 0.0 min: 98 % A / 2 % B; Step 2 – 1.5 min: 90 % A / 10 % B; Step 3 – 11.5 min: 65 % A / 35 % B; Step 4 – 12.0 min: 20 % A / 80 % B; Step 5 – 13.5 min: 20 % A / 80 % B; Step 6 – 14.0 min: 98 % A / 2 % B; Step 7 – 15.0 min: 98 % A / 2 % B.

steps.title: Ionize peptides
steps.instruction: Direct the eluting peptides to an OptaMax™ NG electrospray ion source operating in positive ion mode with the manufacturer‑specified source parameters.

steps.title: Acquire DIA data
steps.instruction: Run the mass spectrometer in data‑independent acquisition (DIA) mode with a duty cycle of 3 survey scans followed by 45 MS² scans; use the survey‑scan and MS²‑scan settings described in the instrument method.

steps.title: Perform weekly mass calibration
steps.instruction: Calibrate the mass axis each week to achieve <3 ppm mass accuracy without applying internal calibrant correction.

steps.title: Conduct quarterly system calibration
steps.instruction: Execute a full system calibration at least every three months, or more frequently if a transmission tune fails or any performance issue arises.

steps.title: Monitor system performance
steps.instruction: At the start, middle, and end of large sample batches, inject 20 µg of an E. coli cell‑lysate tryptic digest, acquire a full LC‑MS/MS run, and evaluate protein identifications, mass accuracy, peak shape, and peptide resolution.

steps.title: Analyze data with DIA‑NN
steps.instruction: Process the acquired DIA raw files using DIA‑NN version 1.8.1 in library‑free mode for peptide identification and quantification; note that DIA‑NN can also accept experimentally generated spectral libraries if desired.

steps.title: Visualize results in Jupyter
steps.instruction: Import the DIA‑NN output into a Jupyter notebook and follow the established LFQ proteomics workflow to compute protein quantities and generate visualizations.
